Windows convert viewer-local to UTC via the existing safeTimezone / toUtcDatetimeFor helpers. Ranking cache moves off LEADER_CACHE_PREFIX onto a class-neutral rememberedRange that calls baseDashboardCacheTTL(0). recovery_scans audit is a written finding. Recovery Leader leaves ClickhouseQuery::query() and keeps viewer-local dates against repo_date.
non_goals: Calling scan-plate-stats cache keys from the hit leader
Editing RecoveryCounts or RecoveryTotalsBatchQuery (the RecoveryCounts batching neighbor)
Closing or implementing the view-without-FINAL gap
Keying the Staging Live result by kit_name

subtasks.title: Rollup query, UTC bounds, class-neutral rememberedRange
subtasks.approach: On StagingLiveHitLeaderQuery, add handleRangeSql and handleRange modeled on ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::handleRangeSql / handleRange. SQL: GROUP BY kit_id WITH ROLLUP, GROUPING(kit_id) AS is_rollup, uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'S') AS total, the existing anyLast(kit_name) blank fallback, FROM hits_cold FINAL, WHERE kit_org_id and _peerdb_is_deleted = 0. Before interpolation, convert start and end with ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery::toUtcDatetimeFor. Do not interpolate a timezone into this SQL. Return {totals: array<int,int>, names: array<int,string>} with totals[0] = the rollup row. Drop a kit_id 0 detail row the way handleRange does. Empty result is totals[0] = 0. Add sharedRangeCacheKey(org, start, end, timezone) as a class-neutral concat with a -v1 suffix and :tz=, no class basename, spaces stripped, assertDatetime on start and end. Add rememberedRange that cache()->remember's that key with TTL from (new class using ResolvesDashboardCacheTtl) or an equivalent call to baseDashboardCacheTTL(0) — impersonation 10 seconds, otherwise 10 minutes. The callback calls handleRange and must not catch Throwable (a failure writes nothing). Delete handle() LIMIT 10 and handleMonthly() once t2 has no caller; until then leave them so the suite stays loadable, and stop new callers. Do not edit ScanPlateStatsBatchQuery.
subtasks.intended_diffs: New rollup SQL still contains uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'S'), kit_org_id, and kit_id, and does not contain hotlist_org_id or a bare count(). A test with two kits and a shared plate shows totals[0] is the org uniq, not the sum of the kit rows. A non-UTC zone converts the bound before the SQL string (the interpolated toDateTime literal is UTC). safeTimezone is not applied inside handleRangeSql. An invalid datetime string throws. sharedRangeCacheKey does not contain a class basename.

subtasks.approach: RecoveryLeaderQuery: replace addslashes on start and end with a Y-m-d allowlist that throws on mismatch. Keep the comparisons on repo_date. subtasks.title: recovery_scans written audit (AC6)
subtasks.approach: During implement, write docs/investigations/DEV-2654/recovery-scans-audit.md. Read-only aggregates on the fleet Docker ClickHouse from the ledger for this key. A pgsql mirror and Cloud ClickHouse writes are not the measurement. Compare, for one org and one repo_date window: (1) RecoveryLeaderQuery's fractional total versus an equal split of distinct kits per recovery_id (the query weights by count() of junction rows); (2) uniqExact(recovery_id) from clarity.lpr_assists versus the same read with FINAL and _peerdb_is_deleted = 0 on clarity.recovery_scans; (3) confirm the query filters repo_date and does not apply a scanned_at predicate (the 90-day window lives in the Cloud scoring job, okf/concepts/lpr-assist.md). Record schema ORDER BY (recovery_id, scan_id), not the view-without-FINAL ticket sentence. If the only defect is the view without FINAL, cite the view-without-FINAL gap and do not open a duplicate and do not change the view. Any other defect gets one follow-up ticket, listed in the finding, not fixed in this story. If the fractions and the FINAL read match the documented leader metric (fractional kit credit, not the LPR Assists KPI), the finding is accurate-as-is and says so with the numbers. Kit-name keying (handle L51) is an audit seed: call it a defect only if the measurement shows a collision.
subtasks.intended_diffs: The file states accurate-as-is or a defect list. It names the view-without-FINAL gap when the view gap is observed. It does not contain a CREATE VIEW or an ALTER.
